newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean court approves arrest of Hanbo founder.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean court approves arrest of Hanbo founder.

text.p: A Seoul court on Friday issued an arrest warrant for the founder of the troubled Hanbo Group over a loan scandal case, a prosecution official said.
"The court granted our request for the arrest warrant for Chung Tae-soo," the official told Reuters.
"Mr Chung will be arrested later today and taken to a Seoul prison," the official said.
Chung, who was summoned from a hospital on Thursday, has been questioned on how he secured billions of dollars in loans to Hanbo Steel Co despite the company's shaky financial status.
Hanbo Steel is the flagship of South Korea's 14th largest conglomerate.
It defaulted on debt repayments last week after borrowing five trillion won ($5.8 billion) from 61 banks and financial institutions.
